seriesStmt.title: Gregor Joseph Werner: A thematic catalogue of his works

annot.p: The style of this mass suggests a date of composition in the early 1730s. However, no work entitled “Missa victoriosa” appears in Werner's inventory of 1737. Since the title page has been written by Kraus, it is possible that originally, the mass had a different title and is actually one of the lost masses mentioned in the inventory.
da capo of the respective movement in Sanctus
